quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on Jared Allen's impact and energy
quotes.excerpt: his presence on the floor really brings us all together
quotes.quote: I think just his presence on the floor really brings us all together. The way he protects the paint, the way he dives on the floor, makes the extra effort, it gives us energy, and I think we just feed off that energy. We got to do a better job of giving him those easy ones back so he continues to keep doing that.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen's impact: His presence on the floor really brings us all together. The way he protects the paint and makes the extra effort gives us energy and we just feed off that.

structured.context: Evan Mobley discusses the energy and defensive impact Jarrett Allen brings to the team after a game against the Nets.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on fixing defensive lapses against three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: we got to know teams' tendencies and what they like to do
quotes.quote: Each game was a little different on how it all happened. This game we did a little better coming out of the half and playing our brand of basketball throughout, but they started shooting a lot of threes. We got to know teams' tendencies and what they like to do, especially if they're down like that. The main thing is they're going to get threes up and try to get it back, so we got to recognize that as soon as possible and get them off the line.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley says the Cavs need to improve their defensive recognition against teams hunting threes: We got to know teams' tendencies and what they like to do. We got to recognize that as soon as possible and get them off the line.

structured.context: Evan Mobley explains the need for better defensive recognition against the Nets' three-point shooting.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on learning from close games early in season
quotes.excerpt: it's a good thing that we're facing it right now, because you don't want to face it later
quotes.quote: I feel like it's a good thing that we're facing it right now, because you don't want to face it later in the playoffs. We definitely got to do better though, to where that doesn't even happen at all. We're going to keep watching film and figure out different things that will make it easier for us. Overall, I think we did a better job tonight and we just got to keep getting better and better as it goes on.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on the team facing early season close games: I feel like it's a good thing that we're facing it right now because you don't want to face it later in the playoffs.

structured.context: Evan Mobley reflects on the importance of learning from close game situations early in the season.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on finding go-to players in crunch time
quotes.excerpt: it's kind of a feel and also I think we got to figure out our go-to plays
quotes.quote: It's kind of a feel and also I think we got to figure out our go-to plays as well, also how they're playing us. Tonight they were sending doubles, so it's a little bit different than say the other night. It's all kind of not just an easy answer, but we got to watch the film and figure out what teams are going to do to us and find solutions to beat that.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on the Cavs' crunch time offense: We got to figure out our go-to plays as well as how they are playing us. Tonight they were sending doubles so it is a little bit different.

structured.context: Evan Mobley discusses the team's process for identifying go-to plays and handling defensive double teams.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on building chemistry with new teammates

quotes.quote: It's two games in, so we still got a long season and a lot more games to go. Every single time we step on the floor we're getting more and more comfortable with each other and we're watching film on what tendencies they like to do and what we like to do. quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on team chemistry and training camp in Spain
quotes.excerpt: I think we just all click together
quotes.quote: I think we just all click together. We all have fun and off the court we went to Spain for training camp, that was a great time. Spent a lot of time together just learning each other and I think that translates onto the court as well. In situations like this when we're up 20 and they're coming back, I think that's going to bring us even closer together as well and figure out who's going to be what in certain situations.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley credits the team's training camp in Spain for their current chemistry: We spent a lot of time together just learning each other and I think that translates onto the court.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on Jared Allen's perimeter shooting development
quotes.excerpt: anytime he hits a three, gives us all energy
quotes.quote: The team loves it. Anytime he hits a three, gives us all energy. He's been working on that all summer, so I think whenever the time comes, he's not backing down from those shots. Tonight that was a great shot by him and it just brings us all up and brings us energy and we just feed off that.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on Jarrett Allen's perimeter shooting: The team loves it. Anytime he hits a three it gives us all energy. He has been working on that all summer so he is not backing down from those shots.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on playing winning basketball and stepping out of comfort zone
quotes.excerpt: I'm just out there trying to play winning basketball
quotes.quote: Personally, I'm just out there trying to play winning basketball every single time I step on the floor. Every single minute I'm trying to do whatever it takes, whether that's me on the defensive end covering up the paint as best I can or offensively scoring or setting a good screen for my guard to come off. I'm just playing winning basketball, so if that needs me to step out my comfort zone and score a lot, then that's what I'm going to do. If not, then I'm going to do whatever is necessary.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on his offensive role: I am just playing winning basketball. If that needs me to step out of my comfort zone and score a lot then that is what I am going to do.

structured.context: Evan Mobley describes his mindset of doing whatever is necessary to play winning basketball.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on the effectiveness of the inverting pick and roll
quotes.excerpt: I think I'm a great playmaker
quotes.quote: I think I'm a great playmaker. I'm also very tall so I can see over the defense. If they set a good screen, I can just read what's going on and make the pass. If not, if they set a good screen, I'm getting downhill, so me getting downhill is kind of tough for the defense to guard. All those aspects I think is a good situation for me.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on his playmaking ability: I think I am a great playmaker. I am also very tall so I can see over the defense. If they set a good screen I can just read what is going on and make the pass.

structured.context: Evan Mobley discusses his development as a playmaker and his effectiveness in the pick and roll.

quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on his three-point shot: I am really confident. Every single year I get more and more confident and seeing a few go down already is just going to keep building my confidence.
